data.description: Dubai Silicon Oasis: Where Tranquility, Luxury, and Elegance Await You

data.answer:
Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO) is a vibrant community focused on quality living and innovation. It offers easy access to essential amenities, ensuring residents have everything they need within reach. The community is classified into three categories: innovation technology park, villa compounds, and residential towers.

Schools and universities in nearby Academic City make Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO) an excellent choice for renting apartments. The community is well-connected with a comprehensive road network, offering easy access to hospitals, schools, and supermarkets.

Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO) is one of Dubai's oldest and most established communities. It was designed as an innovative free zone that blends technology-driven industries with residential areas. DSO is a top choice for tenants and buyers in the UAE, offering a variety of properties.
The apartments in Dubai Silicon Oasis offer spacious layouts with en-suite bedrooms, floor-to-ceiling windows, and built-in wardrobes. Most units also feature fully fitted, enclosed kitchens and spacious balconies.

Uniestate Millennium Tower is one of the properties available for sale in Dubai Silicon Oasis. The 13-story building features studio and 1-bedroom apartments. Residents enjoy various amenities, like a gym and swimming pool. Similarly, Binghatti Point at Dubai Silicon Oasis is a popular choice for studio or 1-bedroom apartments.

DSO has two villa communities, Cedre Villas and Semmer Villas, with over 1,600 units. These villas boast spacious living areas and modern amenities. Dubai Silicon Oasis townhouses also offer an array of family-friendly amenities, making them ideal for families and working professionals.

Properties for Rent in Dubai Silicon Oasis

If you are looking to rent in Dubai Silicon Oasis, you'll find plenty of living options, including apartments and villas. You can rent a studio apartment for around AED 41,000 per year or a one-bedroom apartment for about AED 56,000 annually.

Two-bedroom apartments are available for around AED 79,000, while three-bedroom apartments go for about AED 116,000 per annum. In Cedre Villas, one-bedroom apartments are available, starting at AED 55,000 monthly.

Properties for Sale in Dubai Silicon Oasis

Interested in buying properties in Dubai Silicon Oasis? You can find studios for around AED 405,000. One-bedroom apartments typically cost about AED 599,000. If you need more space, two-bedroom apartments are priced at approximately AED 1,032,000, and three-bedroom units cost around AED 1,549,000.
Cedre Villas offers luxurious amenities to its residents, and prices start at AED 4,001,000 for a three-bedroom villa. The prime location and diverse property options make DSO an excellent investor choice.

more_info.question: What's Life Like in Dubai Silicon Oasis?

data.answer:
Residents of Dubai Silicon Oasis enjoy a vibrant, community-focused lifestyle with modern amenities and a blend of residential and commercial spaces. From affordable apartments to luxury villas, DSO offers diverse housing options. The well-connected area features lush parks, schools, shopping centers, and recreational facilities. Dubai Silicon Oasis perfectly balances convenience, innovation, and comfortable living in a dynamic environment.

Public Transportation in Dubai Silicon Oasis

Dubai Silicon Oasis is well-connected to the public transportation network, making commuting easy for residents. The nearest metro station to Dubai Silicon Oasis is Centerpoint Metro Station, about 15 minutes away. Several RTA bus routes serve the area, linking it to the station.

Taxis and ride-sharing services are also readily available. The community's strategic location along key highways provides convenient access to Dubai's central business districts and attractions.

Supermarkets in Dubai Silicon Oasis

Residents of Dubai Silicon Oasis enjoy easy access to several supermarkets within the community, ensuring all daily needs are met. Popular options include Spinneys, Carrefour, and Choithrams, all located close to residential areas.

Moreover, the supermarkets in Dubai Silicon Oasis offer a wide range of products, including fresh produce, household items, and international brands, making grocery shopping convenient for those living in Dubai Silicon Oasis apartments.

Shopping Malls Near Dubai Silicon Oasis

While Dubai Silicon Oasis has a mall named Silicon Central Mall, residents can also quickly access nearby malls like Dragon Mart and City Centre Mirdif. These malls offer a variety of retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment facilities. For those seeking a more extensive shopping experience, the Dubai Mall is just a short drive away, offering endless shopping, dining, and leisure activities.

Schools Near Dubai Silicon Oasis

Families living in Dubai Silicon Oasis can access several reputable schools. Options include GEMS Wellington Academy, Dubai International Academic City, and Indian International School, all offering high-quality education.

The proximity of these schools makes Dubai Silicon Oasis an ideal location for families with school-going children, providing easy commutes and a wide range of curricular and extracurricular programs.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Dubai Silicon Oasis

Dubai Silicon Oasis is home to several mosques, including the Al Waha Mosque and Cedre Mosque, catering to the community's Muslim residents. For other religious communities, churches like St. Mary's Catholic Church and temples like the Hindu Temple in Bur Dubai are easily accessible from DSO. These places of worship near Dubai Silicon Oasis offer spiritual solace to residents from diverse religious backgrounds.

Clinics and Hospitals in Dubai Silicon Oasis

Healthcare in Dubai Silicon Oasis is easily accessible, with several nearby clinics and hospitals. Aster Clinic and Magnum Gulf Medical Center are popular choices for residents seeking medical care.

For more comprehensive medical services, residents can visit hospitals near Dubai Silicon Oasis, such as Mediclinic City Hospital and Rashid Hospital. These facilities ensure that quality healthcare is always within reach for those living in the area.

Dubai Silicon Oasis Location & Nearby Areas

Dubai Silicon Oasis is strategically located at the intersection of Dubai-Al Ain Road (E66) and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), providing easy access to critical areas in Dubai.

The area is about a 5-minute drive from Academic City, Liwan, and International City Phase 2. The community is about a 20-minute drive from Downtown Dubai, making it a convenient choice for those working in the city center.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Dubai Silicon Oasis

data.answer:
There are plenty of things to do in Dubai Silicon Oasis. You can visit the mall and nearby parks or explore an array of restaurants. Moreover, the area's proximity to iconic attractions in Dubai ensures residents have access to various leisure activities.

Restaurants In and Near Dubai Silicon Oasis

Dubai Silicon Oasis Dubai offers a variety of dining options to cater to diverse tastes. Popular restaurants in Dubai Silicon Oasis include Oregano, which serves Italian cuisine, and Indian Palace for authentic Indian dishes. The nearby My Home Kitchen offers a global menu for those seeking international flavors. These restaurants provide a range of culinary experiences within the community, making dining out convenient for residents of Dubai Silicon Oasis apartments.

Beaches Near Dubai Silicon Oasis

While Dubai Silicon Oasis is an inland community, several beautiful beaches are within a 20-30 minute drive. Jumeirah Beach and Kite Beach are popular sunbathing, swimming, and water sports spots. These beaches near Dubai Silicon Oasis provide a perfect escape for residents looking to relax by the sea. The convenient Dubai Silicon Oasis location ensures you are always close to the serene shores of Dubai.

Hotels in Dubai Silicon Oasis

For those visiting the area, Dubai Silicon Oasis hotel options include Premier Inn Dubai Silicon Oasis, which offers comfortable stays with modern amenities. Hotel apartments in Dubai Silicon Oasis are also available for extended stays, providing a home-like environment with the convenience of hotel services. These accommodations are ideal for business travelers and tourists alike, ensuring a pleasant stay close to the heart of Dubai's tech hub.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Dubai Silicon Oasis

Dubai Silicon Oasis Dubai is strategically located near several key attractions and landmarks. With its extensive shopping and entertainment options, the iconic Dubai Mall is a short drive away. Families can enjoy nearby attractions like Global Village and IMG Worlds of Adventure. The community's proximity to these attractions and its central location in Dubai make it a perfect base for exploring the city's offerings.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Fitness enthusiasts in Dubai Silicon Oasis can access several top-notch gyms, including Gymnation, Nitro Gym, Fit Gym, Max Gym, and Fitness4Life. These gyms in Dubai Silicon Oasis offer various exercise classes and personal training sessions to meet all fitness needs.

Additionally, the community boasts an array of spas and salons like Ombre Salon, Brown Sugar Hair Salon, and Beauty Avenue Salon & Spa. While there are few parks in the area, Mushrif Park, just 21 minutes away, offers extensive outdoor activities, including swimming, camel riding, and cycling.

While Dubai Silicon Oasis offers numerous benefits, it's worth noting that the community is a short drive away from a metro station. However, with its well-connected road network and alternative transportation options, getting around the city remains convenient and manageable.

Is DIFC freehold or leasehold?

Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO) offers both freehold and leasehold properties. For residential purposes, freehold areas are available where expatriates can purchase property with full ownership rights. However, some commercial properties in DSO may be available on a leasehold basis.

Is there a Dubai Silicon Oasis property for sale?  

Yes, Dubai Silicon Oasis offers various properties for sale, including apartments, villas, and townhouses, catering to different budgets and preferences.

How can I find an apartment in Dubai Silicon Oasis?  

If you are looking for an apartment in the area, you can check Zoya Ventures Real Estate’s listings for properties for sale in the area. To find out about the upcoming projects in the area, check out our listings for off-plan properties in Dubai Silicon Oasis.

Is Dubai Silicon Oasis a good place to live?

Yes, Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO) is considered a good place to live, especially for families and professionals. It is a well-planned community that offers a balanced lifestyle with a mix of residential, commercial, and recreational facilities. The area is known for its affordable housing options, modern amenities, schools, parks, shopping centers, and a vibrant community atmosphere. It also provides convenient access to major highways, making it easy to commute to other parts of Dubai.

Why is it called Silicon Oasis?

Dubai Silicon Oasis is named to reflect its status as a technology park and hub for innovation, similar to Silicon Valley in the United States. The "Silicon" part of the name signifies its focus on technology, electronics, and IT-related industries. The "Oasis" represents a thriving, green, and self-sufficient community within the desert, providing a favorable environment for both businesses and residents.

Where is Dubai Silicon Oasis?

Dubai Silicon Oasis is located in the eastern part of Dubai, near major highways such as Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) and Dubai-Al Ain Road (E66). It is situated between Dubai's central business districts and the outskirts, offering easy access to key areas like Downtown Dubai, Dubai International Airport, and other residential communities.

Who lives in Dubai Silicon Oasis?

Dubai Silicon Oasis is home to a diverse community of residents, including families, professionals, and expatriates from various nationalities. The area is particularly popular with individuals working in technology, IT, and engineering fields due to its proximity to tech companies and business hubs. The community also attracts young professionals and families who are looking for affordable housing in a well-connected and modern neighborhood.

data.content:
Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO), situated at the crossroads of Dubai-Al Ain Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, is a family-friendly community. It is an integrated technology park and free trade zone that offers residents a well-rounded lifestyle where they can live, work, and play in one convenient location.

Dubai Silicon Oasis offers a variety of living options, including apartments, penthouses, villas, and townhouses – great for families and individuals.

Established in 2004, Dubai Silicon Oasis has emerged as one of the best luxury real estate investment options. The community provides all amenities, including schools, dining, shopping, and healthcare.

nodes.title: Binghatti Point
nodes.about:
Binghatti Point is a modern 10-storey residential development located in Dubai's historic Dubai Silicon Oasis neighborhood. The project offers upscale 1-2 bedroom apartments with magnificent views of the city and ocean.

The Binghatti Point building is characterized by its contemporary design and innovative architecture. The interiors have the highest quality finishes. Residents here can enjoy a high level of comfort and quality services.

The Binghatti Point complex also provides extensive infrastructure facilities to the residents including a state-of-the-art fitness center, swimming pool, recreational areas, playgrounds and parking spaces. In addition, the building has a 24-hour security service to provide residents with the highest level of safety and security.

Located in a popular area of Dubai, Binghatti Point enjoys a convenient location with excellent infrastructure and proximity to key city facilities such as shopping malls, restaurants, schools and office buildings. Downtown Dubai and DIFC are just 10 minutes away, Dubai International Airport can be reached in 15 minutes and Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina and the world's largest airport, Al Maktoum International Airport are no more than 30 minutes away by car.

Binghatti Point is a quality property that offers residents comfortable living in modern and stylish surroundings with beautiful views of the surrounding landscape. The complex is ideal for couples with children, and investors can receive a stable high income from renting out the apartments.
